cap: Each high-yield teratogen has one signature effect to recognize. ACE inhibitors cause renal failure and oligohydramnios, warfarin nasal hypoplasia and stippled epiphyses, valproate and carbamazepine neural tube defects, phenytoin hypoplastic nails, lithium Ebstein anomaly, thalidomide phocomelia, tetracyclines stained teeth, and alcohol a smooth philtrum.
teach: Isotretinoin and excess vitamin A cause craniofacial, cardiac and central nervous system defects. Methotrexate is a folate antagonist that causes limb and craniofacial defects and fetal loss. Aminoglycosides injure the eighth nerve. Diethylstilbestrol exposure in utero causes vaginal clear cell adenocarcinoma and a T-shaped uterus in daughters. Cocaine causes placental abruption by vasoconstriction. Methimazole causes aplasia cutis and choanal atresia, so propylthiouracil is used in the first trimester. Misoprostol causes the Mobius sequence of facial and abducens palsies. Mycophenolate causes microtia and clefts, topiramate causes cleft lip, and NSAIDs late in pregnancy close the ductus arteriosus and cause oligohydramnios. Heparin does not cross the placenta, so it replaces warfarin for anticoagulation.
